description:
PSP port with fake provider (incl. 3DS-like challenge and failure simulation), multi-currency orders and per-currency settlement. Real PSP adapter is the epic's tail, kept out of M-early scope.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Orders price and settle in any configured currency; no float arithmetic anywhere
- Fake PSP simulates success/decline/timeout/challenge deterministically for tests
- PSP port proven swappable: fake and (later) real adapter behind the same contract

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.
